linkTitle: Rabbi David Ebner: A sharp, sensitive, story-telling rabbi | The Jerusalem Post
linkDescription: When he led us in prayer, we felt the heavens open. Amid the awe, he would sweep us up in joyous dance, drawing his students into the profound intensity of his prayers.
